acceptance.statement: This report proves only deterministic byte-exact inventory/extraction of SWF-embedded codec payloads. Language, cue mapping, audible content/quality, runtime timing/synchronization, authoritative playback, human review, owner acceptance, parity, and strict migration completion remain unresolved.
